title: SAL-01 Sales UK
summary: Cost centre for UK sales under owner IMORGAN, open in unit NBC-MAN-01 with £358,796.35 available budget for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre SAL-01 covers Sales UK operations at Northbridge Cycles, active under business unit NBC-MAN-01 and owned by IMORGAN [^r1]. For the fourth quarter of 2026, it operates with a total allocated budget of £538,000, against which £179,203.65 has been committed as of 26 October 2026 09:00 [^r2]. This leaves an available balance of £358,796.35 for remaining quarterly expenditure [^r2].

## Cost centre details

SAL-01 is currently OPEN in the master register under operating unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. Budget tracking and ownership reside with user IMORGAN [^r1].

Master data and quarterly ledger balances are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2].
